# Vendored development dependency

`lo-ink-bot-sdk-0.3.0.tgz` is the prepared media and keyboard build from the
coordinated `fix/vysotka-sdk-feedback` branch, based on Bot SDK main `8ef7757`.
It is MIT licensed and is not published yet. Runtime consumers provide
`@lo-ink/bot-sdk ^0.3.0`.
